package: @astryxdesign/core

# useTreeFocusHookUsage - A custom file tree built from plain rows with tree roles. useTreeFocus gives it the WAI-ARIA tree keyboard model: ArrowUp and ArrowDown move over the visible rows, ArrowRight opens a folder or moves into it, ArrowLeft closes it or moves to its parent, Home and End jump to the ends, a typed letter jumps to a matching name, Enter opens a file, and only one row is in the tab order.
# Components: 

<HStack gap={1} role="treeitem">
  <Icon />
  <Icon />
  <Text />
</HStack>
<VStack gap={3} width={240}>
  <VStack gap={1} role="tree">
  </VStack>
  <Text />
</VStack>
